lines.text: The Danites, still without an inheritance, sent five men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land.
The spies recognized the young Levite's voice at Micah's house, and the priest told them the LORD was watching over their journey.
The spies found Laish quiet and unsuspecting, with no alliance with anyone, and urged their brothers to go up and take it.
Six hundred armed Danites left Zorah and Eshtaol and camped at Kiriath-jearim in Benjamin.
The Danites struck Laish with their swords, burned the city, rebuilt it, and renamed it Bethel after their forefather.
